full_page.content:
1946, June 22
The following is a faithful transcription of handwritten message by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap. on the flyleaf of the Abridged copy of The Mystical City of God.
"To know is to appreciate -- is to love the good and to reject the unworthy. God Himself will be no exception in this. "God is Charity," St. John tells us, and Saint Francis laments: "Love is not loved." Ah! because not known! But if artists can be known by their masterpieces, why should not the divine Architect ofthe Universe by known by His ?- Theologians are quite agreed that Mary, our Blessed Mother -- Virgin Mother of Jesus -- was so imbued with divine gifts and graces-even at her very Immaculate Conception-as to surpass in beauty of sanctity all other creatures combined.
The following pages, even abridged as they are, offer a surpassing introduction to God's own Mother, being the Autobiography of the same outstanding and supreme Masterpiece of all Masterpieces of the Universe -- most inspired-like and most inspiring - when read with becoming reverence. August 3, 1947, Huntingtonn. Father Solanus O.S.M.Cap. Sinner
Original Volume Possession of: Rev. John Mccluskey S.J. East 502 Boone Ave. Spokane, Washington 99202
Copied by Winifred G. O'Donnell (Mrs. Joseph J. O'Donnell) 1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago, Illinois
